business.name: Garage Door Guys
business.tagline: When your door won't budge, we make it move

hero.headline: When your door won't budge, *we make it move*
hero.subheadline: Same-day service in Jacksonville — because a stuck garage door doesn't wait for Monday.

services_section.label: WHAT WE FIX
services_section.heading: Every spring, cable, and track
services_section.subheading: From broken springs to stuck doors — if it moves up and down, we handle it.

services.title: Spring Replacement
services.description: Broken springs are the #1 cause of garage door failure. We stock all sizes for same-day replacement.

services.title: Door Repair
services.description: Bent tracks, damaged panels, or doors that won't stay closed. We straighten, replace, and adjust.

services.title: Opener Service
services.description: Motor running but door not moving? Chain off track? We diagnose and fix all opener issues.

services.title: Emergency Repair
services.description: Car trapped inside or door stuck open? We prioritize emergency calls and respond fast.

about.heading: Jacksonville's garage door team
about.body: We're the Jacksonville crew that shows up when your garage door decides to quit. Real people answering the phone — not a call center.

reviews.name: Billy W.
reviews.text: Outstanding customer service from start to finish. Very prompt service when you need it. Technician had a great attitude and made the whole experience smooth.

reviews.name: Starr A.
reviews.text: Couldn't be happier with the entire experience. Customer service was friendly and professional, arrived on time, diagnosed the issue right away.

reviews.name: Leslie H.
reviews.text: Second time using them and the quality didn't disappoint. Everyone was friendly and professional. Reasonably priced and fast service.

service_areas.label: COVERAGE AREA
service_areas.heading: Serving Jacksonville and surrounding areas
service_areas.subheading: Fast response times throughout Onslow County

cta.heading: Door stuck? Let's fix that today.
cta.body: Quick diagnosis, upfront pricing, same-day service when possible. No hidden fees, no runaround.
